author: Vikram Shetty
alert_description: checkout-api p99 latency is 3,855 ms on POST /v1/checkout (threshold 2,000 ms)

details.diff: LightGBM artifact v52: adds merchant_velocity_24h; feature cache moved from the bounded LRU (50k entries) to an in-process dict keyed by merchant and hour

discriminators: fraud-scorer memory saws up to the 2Gi limit and drops at each restart
a new model artifact was released shortly before the leak started

steps.note: recognised the INC-4150 pattern and rolled the model back to v51

migration_context: 9 days after the PgBouncer migration (M1, 3 Sep); 2 days after the Redis to Valkey migration (M2, 10 Sep)
